summary.headline: Week ahead of target on both orders and revenue, but the quarter is behind at 96.8% and the year at 94.1% of target.

points.what: Orders reached 914 against a target of 889, giving attainment of 102.8%, and revenue of $68,099 came in at 104.5% of its target.
points.so_what: The week added to the quarter's position rather than deepening the shortfall.

points.what: Revenue was up 3.3% on the prior week and is flagged as notable because it sits outside its 8-week range.
points.so_what: This week's revenue level should not be read as the established pace of recent months.

points.what: Orders fell 3.6% week on week to 914, a move rated bad, while revenue rose.
points.so_what: Revenue growth this week came from higher value per order rather than more orders.

points.what: QTD revenue is $450,760 against a target to date of $465,479, a gap of -$14,719 with 6 weeks left in the quarter.
points.so_what: Beating the weekly target once is not enough to close the quarter gap on its own.

points.what: The 14-Day Return Rate for the mature week of 27 Apr 2026 rose to 11.3%, up 1.3 pp, the third consecutive move in the bad direction from 8.7%.
points.so_what: A three-week bad-direction streak means the return trend is not reversing.

points.what: YTD revenue stands at 94.1% of target, with every month from January through May (MTD) behind target.
points.so_what: The shortfall against the year is persistent rather than a one-week effect.

points.what: Hitting the full-year target of $3,888,802 requires $82,500 of revenue a week across the remaining 33 weeks, against a current 8-week run-rate of $64,014.
points.so_what: The full-year target requires a step up well beyond the recent pace.

points.what: Orders finished the week at 102.8% of target and revenue at 104.5%, both ahead.
points.so_what: Both headline KPIs cleared the weekly bar, so the week itself was not the source of the quarter's shortfall.

points.what: QTD revenue attainment is 96.8%, behind target, with $433,326 still needed in 6 weeks to reach the full-quarter target of $884,086.
points.so_what: The quarter needs weeks well above this one's revenue to land on target.

points.what: YTD revenue attainment is 94.1%, a gap of -$73,717 against the target to date.
points.so_what: The required run-rate for the rest of the year sits far above the recent 8-week pace, so the year remains out of reach at this rate.

points.what: North America orders fell 11.7% to 197, contributing -26 orders and 76.5% of the week's change.
points.so_what: Most of the orders decline sits in one region rather than being spread across the business.

points.what: Display orders dropped 44.4% to 25, contributing -20 orders and 58.8% of the change, the largest traffic-source contributor.
points.so_what: The smallest traffic source accounted for the biggest single share of the orders decline.

points.what: APAC held at 402 orders, up 0.2%, and remains 44.0% of all orders.
points.so_what: The largest region did not offset the declines elsewhere this week.

points.what: AOV rose 6.1% week on week to $87.98 and is up 5.7% on last year, both rated good.
points.so_what: This is how revenue rose in a week when orders fell.

points.what: The cancellation rate improved to 15.3%, down 0.8 pp on the week and 1.0 pp on last year.
points.so_what: Each percentage point of cancellations is worth $804 of revenue, so the improvement supported this week's target beat.

points.what: New signups rose 21.2% to 252, a notable move, and are up 13.0% on last year.
points.so_what: Signup growth is running well below the 77.1% year-on-year growth in orders, so the two are not moving in step.

points.what: The 14-Day Return Rate for the mature week of 27 Apr 2026 was 11.3%, up 1.1 pp on last year and rated bad.
points.so_what: Order quality on returns is weaker than a year ago even as cancellations improve.

checks.name: 14-Day Return Rate names its mature week
anomaly flag acknowledged in the summary
sentences at most 30 words and 4 numbers
each slot only covers its allowed KPIs
